Maps and music in a half window

Opens Maps, Waze or music in a free-form window on one side and keeps LiteDash visible on the rest. First turn on, in Android Settings → Developer options: "Force activities to be resizable" and "Enable freeform windows", then restart the tablet. If the system does not allow it, the app opens normally.
GPS shows the real speed; a car dashboard reads high. With 7 %, 100 km/h real shows as 107, like your car.
